title: Strawberry Fields Forever - Wikipedia
notes: The released record joins take 7 (sped up) to take 26 (slowed down) at about 1:00; take 26 is a percussion-heavy track with Starr's drums and backwards-recorded hi-hat and cymbals (Lewisohn); the false ending and the coda's heavy drum and percussion piece; 'the resonant tone of Starr's drums'.

title: Magical Mystery Tour (song) - Wikipedia
notes: Basic track 25 April 1967 with Starr on drums; on 26 April the four Beatles, Mal Evans and Neil Aspinall overdubbed percussion 'and extra drums'. Melody Maker: 'Paul singing lead over a tom-tom beat'; MacDonald: 'unconvincing time and tempo changes'.

title: Hello, Goodbye - Wikipedia
notes: Take 14 with Starr on drums; the coda (the 'Maori finale') 'didn't sound quite right' until Emerick increased the reverberation on the tom-toms (McCartney).
